description: This file contains unit tests for the Orleans Membership Table implementation using Consul as the backend. It verifies operations such as reading, writing, updating, and cleaning up membership entries, as well as gateway discovery, specifically within the context of Consul integration.

classes.name: ConsulMembershipTableTest
classes.description: A test class for verifying the functionality of Orleans Membership Table using Consul as the backend store. It includes tests for gateway discovery, reading, inserting, updating, and cleanup of membership entries.

methods.name: CreateFilters
methods.description: Creates and configures logging filters for the test class.

methods.name: CreateMembershipTable
methods.description: Creates a Consul-based membership table instance for testing.

methods.name: CreateGatewayListProvider
methods.description: Creates a Consul-based gateway list provider for testing.

methods.name: GetConnectionString
methods.description: Retrieves the connection string for the Consul server asynchronously.

methods.name: MembershipTable_Consul_GetGateways
methods.description: Test for verifying gateway discovery via Consul.

methods.name: MembershipTable_Consul_ReadAll_EmptyTable
methods.description: Test for reading from an empty membership table.

methods.name: MembershipTable_Consul_InsertRow
methods.description: Test for inserting a new membership row.

methods.name: MembershipTable_Consul_ReadRow_Insert_Read
methods.description: Test for reading, inserting, and reading again a membership row.

methods.name: MembershipTable_Consul_ReadAll_Insert_ReadAll
methods.description: Test for reading all entries, inserting, and reading all again.

methods.name: MembershipTable_Consul_UpdateRow
methods.description: Test for updating a membership row.

methods.name: MembershipTable_Consul_UpdateRowInParallel
methods.description: Test for concurrent updates to a membership row.

methods.name: MembershipTable_Consul_UpdateIAmAlive
methods.description: Test for updating the liveness heartbeat ('I Am Alive') in Consul.

methods.name: MembershipTable_Consul_CleanupDefunctSiloEntries
methods.description: Test for cleaning up dead or defunct silo entries from the membership table.
